scope: PICES EBA diagnostics; no transport or empty-composition policy changes

snapshot.stage: accepted full thermal step, after TA; before subsequent Stokes update
snapshot.validity: No accepted snapshot at initialization/restart: pices_diagnostics_valid=0 and heat-source profile fields omitted until next accepted step
snapshot.npz: pices_ prefixed scalars with exactly the same snapshot values

profiles.qinternal,qvisc,qadi,qadi_base,qphase: Element-volume averages, time-weighted over accepted heat substeps; trial/rejected updates not counted
profiles.qassim: Accepted TA-only projected temperature increment weighted by the same frozen effective capacity as PICES_TA, divided by element volume and full dt
profiles.qadi_base: Same as qadi in this EBA path
profiles.qphase: Sink-positive pressure-driven phase term; temperature-dependent latent contribution is in effective capacity
profiles.qtotal: qinternal + qvisc - qadi - qphase + qassim; excludes diffusion, boundary reaction, remap and reconciliation
profiles.units: Existing nondimensional source-density units; multiply by pices_source_scale_W_m3 for W/m^3

energy.definition: Integral of frozen effective heat capacity times nondimensional grid temperature. Not a thermodynamic enthalpy claim.
energy.balance: energy_after - energy_before = remap + capacity_rebase + internal_input - adiabatic_sink + viscous_input - phase_sink + boundary_reaction + ta_storage + reconciliation + closure_residual
energy.capacity_rebase: Independently measured change caused by rebuilding capacity at fixed grid temperature; not physical external heating
energy.boundary_reaction: Heat-stage constrained-node FE reaction, positive into domain; not an instantaneous CBF flux
energy.units: Nondimensional integrated quantities; multiply by energy_scale_J for J
energy.heat_residual: heat_storage - internal_input + adiabatic_sink - viscous_input + phase_sink - boundary_reaction

statistics.particle_temperature: Kelvin min/max and particle-count-weighted mean; not volume weighted
statistics.particle_count: Sum of owned particles over all ranks
statistics.grid_temperature: Kelvin min/max of final grid temperature

other_profiles: Grid temperature/material fields and Stokes mechanical snapshot retain existing definitions and may have different stages from accepted heat sources.
